segments.text: Good morning. I am calling from the bank about your personal loan inquiry.
Yes. I would like to borrow €15,000 for a car.
Before we continue, please confirm your date of birth and your postcode.
Thank you. The loan would run over 5 years at a fixed rate of 6.9%.
I am calling because your loan application is missing two recent pay slips.
Can I upload them in the app instead of sending them by post?
Yes, upload them in the Documents section and we will review them within two working days.
To check affordability I need your monthly income after tax.
it is about 3200 euros. and my rent is 900.
Do you have any other loans or credit card balances at the moment?
Only a credit card with around 400 euros on it.
Am I speaking with Mr. Max Keller, the main account holder?
Yes, that is me. My account number ends in 4417.
Thank you, Mr. Keller. I can now go through the loan offer with you.
Identity verified with two security questions before any account details were shared.
You asked about the early repayment fee on your loan.
Yes, if I pay it all back next year, how much extra will that cost me?
The fee is 1% of the amount you repay early, and we will confirm it in writing.
I have both applicants on the line, so I will ask each of you to confirm the details.
Hello. I am the second applicant. Can you hear me?
Can you hear me? Yes. We can both hear you fine.
good. We would like the repayments to come out on the first of each month.
that works. I will note the first of the month as the payment date.
Call note. The customer asked for a three-month repayment holiday after losing a second job.
I explained that interest keeps building up during the break and the loan term gets longer.
referred to the financial support team, and a follow-up call is booked for Friday.
your fixed mortgage rate ends next month, so I am calling with the new options.
What would the two year fixed rate be?
4.1 percent, and there is no arrangement fee if you switch this month.
Thanks for calling back about the mortgage application you started this morning.
Do you need anything else from me before the valuation?
Only a copy of your latest bank statement, then we can book the valuation.
